import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    lim = a[k - 1]
    ans = sum(1 for x in a if x > 0 and x >= lim)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
